audience: shop owners and store managers who run their point of sale with Smaregi

useCases.title: Review a store's sales transactions for a day
useCases.text: The AI lists sales transactions (receipts) for a store in a time window of up to 31 days, and reads one transaction with its line items, discounts and payments.

useCases.title: Find products that are low on stock
useCases.text: The AI reads stock levels and reserved amounts per store and product, with the product names, and points out the ones running low.

useCases.title: Check the stock history of a product
useCases.text: The AI reads the stock changes of one product in one store, with date, amount and type such as sale, purchase, transfer or adjustment.

useCases.title: Add a product or update its details
useCases.text: The AI changes fields of a product, such as its price or name, or creates a product with a category, name and price.

useCases.title: Set or adjust the stock of a product in a store
useCases.text: The AI sets the exact stock quantity of a product in a store, or adds or subtracts a quantity from it.

useCases.title: Add or update a customer (member)
useCases.text: The AI lists customers by code, member number or update time, creates a member, or changes fields of an existing one.
